headline: On 10 fixtures Claude reads 52% fewer tokens (98,400 → 47,223; −92% on the 6 long outputs the mod trims) and no critical line is lost. Jev was asked on 3 cases only. Fix the 3 Major review findings and measure on real logs before using it.

deviations: Same fixtures were used to write the rules and to measure them (in-sample): real logs may do worse.
Tokens = what Claude would read for the command output, counted for real via claude -p (haiku); not a full agent session, so no execution log.
4 of 10 cases are pass-through by design (short, unmatched, piped, malformed) and show no change.
evaluation.tokenScope: only the command output Claude reads (one Bash result), not the whole session
